name: Improved Attenuation
body:
Prerequisite(s): Dire Attenuation

Benefit(s): This is as dire attenuation, but by excluding an additional foe from your dire zone you may select one additional foe within 15′ of your dire zone to include within its effects. This feat may be combined with Precise Attenuation. Changing your dire zone’s shape or area from its current shape or area is a move action.
